title: First Invoice after a Move to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan — Installment Payment Plans Calculation Memorandum
content:
This memorandum defines the first invoice a plan of the **Installment Payment Plans** receives when an Owner Auto Policy term's plan is moved off automatic draft to the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan at the named insured's request (US dollars; rounding to the cent, half up).

## 1. Quantities at the move

- **Installments left:** the plan's number of installments less the installment invoices already issued on the plan, the first invoice's own installment included.
- **Old schedule's down payment premium:** the plan's recorded down payment amount less the fully earned fees it took — the policy fee booked on the owner term and every filing fee the filing ledger of the Financial Responsibility Filings (SR-22 / FR-44) shows assessed on the day the plan was set up for a certificate whose backing term is the owner term, whatever its present status, every filing fee of the customer's assessed that day when every certificate the customer holds rests on that term. When the term the plan bills backs two or more certificates while the customer also holds a certificate on another term, the records do not show which of the set-up day's filing fees the plan took, so the scheduled premium rests on the down payment premium the base down payment rule sets (the full-term premium billed times the plan's new-business down payment percentage for the first term of the policy number it bills, or its renewal percentage for a later term, divided by 100 and rounded) for a plan enrolled on its present plan, and, for a plan switched onto it from another, on the scheduled installment premium recorded on its installment 1 invoice or, while no installment 1 invoice exists, on the base down payment rule's figure for its present plan.
- **Old schedule's installment premium:** the full-term premium billed less that down payment premium, divided by the plan's number of installments, rounded.
- **Premium left on the old schedule:** the full-term premium billed less the old down payment premium and less the old installment premium once for each installment already invoiced.
- **Switch down payment the move took:** every payment recorded on the plan toward the first installment not yet invoiced and linked to no invoice.
- **Endorsement premium left to bill:** every additional premium transaction booked on the owner term billed, less the premium the plan's installment invoices have billed beyond the old installment premium for each of them.
- **Standing balance at the move:** the account balance less the premium left on the old schedule and less the endorsement premium left to bill, plus the switch down payment the move took. Positive: an amount billed earlier and still unpaid; negative: a credit the plan holds.
- **Certificate filing fee:** the filing fee recorded on the filing ledger for the certificate recorded first among the filings whose backing term is the term the plan bills (the earliest of those entries, whatever its present status), when that fee was assessed after the plan's latest installment invoice was issued and has not been reversed; a fee assessed on the day an invoice is issued is billed on that invoice. When that term backs more than one certificate, the unbilled filing fee of any further certificate is not billed on that invoice and is referred to the filings desk.

## 2. The first invoice after the move

It bills the **respread installment premium** — the premium left on the old schedule less the switch down payment the move took, divided by the installments left and rounded — with the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan's installment fee of 9.00 and the certificate filing fee, and carries the standing balance, an unpaid earlier amount added and a credit subtracted. Its minimum due is their sum, never less than zero, rounded. Whatever is added to its premium never exceeds, in total, the endorsement premium left to bill; each figure works from the quantities of section 1 alone, so the minimum due is the same in whatever order they are applied. Apart from the old schedule's figures, only shares, any percentage amount billed ahead, and the minimum due are rounded, each half up to the cent.

## 2a. Installment avoided by paying the whole balance

No installment fee is charged on an invoice whose installment was avoided by paying the whole balance before it was invoiced (the plan's account balance at the invoice is zero or less): the installment fee every invoice this memorandum figures would carry is then 0.00, any certificate filing fee still being billed.

## 3. A move outside the schedule

When the move is asked on any other plan or outside the schedule's limits, the plan becomes the Cardinal Point Six-Pay Direct Bill Plan for its remaining installments and its next invoice bills, as the base installment schedule states, that installment's scheduled premium unchanged (the old installment premium, or for the last installment the full-term premium billed less the old down payment premium and less the old installment premium for every earlier installment), the installment fee of 9.00 together with the certificate filing fee above, and the standing balance; its minimum due is never below zero. On a non-owner plan that figure reads the Named Non-Owner Policy term's own policy fee, filing fees and additional premium. A plan with no installment left to invoice, the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan included, has no next installment invoice (0.00).

## 4. Worked figures (hypothetical)

Full-term premium billed 1,450.00; old down payment premium 246.50; old installment premium 1,203.50 divided by 5, 240.70. Two invoices issued, billing 240.70 each; no additional premium; switch down payment taken 78.40; account balance after that payment 643.70. Premium left on the old schedule: 1,450.00 less 246.50 less 481.40, which is 722.10. Installments left: 3. Respread installment premium: 722.10 less 78.40 is 643.70, divided by 3, 214.57. Standing balance: 643.70 less 722.10 plus 78.40, which is 0.00. First invoice: 214.57 plus 9.00, minimum due 223.57.
